method: Full PDF extraction for every supplied document, complete manual reading, Unicode NFKC word-occurrence comparison between source text and web text, excluding running page furniture. Tables and diagram labels reformatted; original PDF visual layouts are not reproduced on the website.
duplicate_policy: Both uploaded librarianship panel documents remain separately indexed. Their identical extracted content shares one web text.
source_discrepancies: Preserved and explained in the reader and source index; no unsupported factual corrections applied.
programme: All scheduled times and concurrent room assignments checked against the official LAS conference page. Programme-only sessions are labelled where no standalone report was supplied.
